summary: Iteration 58 — Full end-to-end backend + frontend testing of Partner & Merchant Registration Wizards. 20/20 pytest cases PASS (0 skipped, 0 fail) covering fresh-account OTP signup, PUT saves for basic/work/documents/address (partner) and basic/shop/shop-photo/address (merchant), score reaching 100, multipart /upload with real JPEGs, Aadhaar OCR path, geo cascade (states/districts/cities), /api/geo/serviceability, /submit → under_review on serviceable pincode (800001 Patna), and demo-approved profile lookup. Frontend Playwright flows also PASS: fresh partner signup routes to /partner/register with 4% score banner + stepper + Basic form; empty Save & Continue shows 'Please fill all required fields' toast; fresh merchant signup routes to /merchant/register; approved partner and approved merchant demo accounts land on the 'Account Under Review' screen (wizard is correctly hidden). No deprecated Expo packages detected in the reg wizard files reviewed.

minor.issue: When the uploaded file is not a valid image, PIL raises UnidentifiedImageError which is NOT a subclass of ValueError, so the except in the route falls through and the API returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of a friendly 400. Repro: POST multipart with bytes b'\xff\xd8\xffTESTJPEG'. Fix suggestion: catch (ValueError, PIL.UnidentifiedImageError, OSError) in routes/partner_reg_routes.py:73 and merchant_reg_routes.py:63, or normalize inside storage_service.save_image to raise ValueError for unreadable images.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: harden /partner/registration/upload and /merchant/registration/upload to return 400 (not 500) on non-image bytes — catch UnidentifiedImageError/OSError in addition to ValueError. Frontend already only uploads real captures so this doesn't affect real users, but it improves error UX for edge cases and for automated smoke tests.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_reg_service.compute_score gives 0/8 fields = 0% for a fresh profile, but `basic.mobile` is auto-populated from phone — mobile isn't in the weighted field list so this is intentional. Merchant _blank_profile pre-fills basic.full_name/email/mobile from the user record, which yields ~8% on a truly-fresh profile (test relaxed accordingly). Not a bug.
merchant save_shop enforces a single category server-side (cats = cats[:1]) — matches partner single-select UI. Good.
Partner submit correctly gates on Verhoeff Aadhaar, live_photo_url, pincode serviceability and 100% score (verified — submit blocked for 110001 Delhi, succeeded for 800001 Patna).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scripted flows verified (partner+merchant fresh signup wizards, validation toast, approved-account status screens)

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates 2 fresh phone-numbered users (+919XXXXXXXXX) via OTP signup. Frontend Playwright runs create 2 additional fresh users. All are prefixed with 'TEST' in name/email; no cleanup script added (users are inert/incomplete profiles).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest run command: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview> EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter58_reg_wizards.py -v. The Aadhaar 234123412346 passes Verhoeff. Serviceable pincodes for E2E submit: 800001 (Patna), 834001 (Ranchi). Non-serviceable example: 110001 (Delhi) — expected to 400 on submit. Fresh phones must be outside +919000000000-+919000000009 (reserved demo range). Frontend intro screen 'Stay in the loop' must be dismissed with 'Maybe later' before login form is reachable.
rca_of_issue: Minor 500 on non-image upload → PIL.UnidentifiedImageError isn't caught by `except ValueError` in the upload route. Reproduction: `curl -F file=@garbage.txt -F doc_type=live_photo -H 'Authorization: Bearer <partner_token>' <BASE>/api/partner/registration/upload` → 500. Mitigation: extend the except clause in partner_reg_routes.py:73 / merchant_reg_routes.py:63 to `except (ValueError, Exception) as e: raise HTTPException(400, ...)` — or, cleaner, catch PIL.UnidentifiedImageError inside storage_service._compress and re-raise as ValueError.
